exposure: status of amniotic membranes at hospital admission
Status of amniotic membranes at hospital admission
outcome: Hourly doses of oxytocin from augmentation initiation until vaginal delivery
cohort: 136 healthy, nulliparous, spontaneously laboring obese women (BMI ≥ 30 kg/m(2)) who received oxytocin augmentation and achieved vaginal delivery
finding: Maternal BMI was a significant predictor of hourly oxytocin doses received, explaining 16.56% of the variance.
